name: ppi-api-workbench
description: One application for the naval radar PPI scope (Kafka + MongoDB) and project-based OpenAPI/Swagger YAML management with dynamic API forms.

scripts.dev: node scripts/check-install.mjs server shared client && npm --workspace server run dev
scripts.build: node scripts/check-install.mjs client && npm --workspace client run build
scripts.build:demo: node scripts/check-install.mjs client && npm --workspace client run build:demo
scripts.start: node scripts/check-install.mjs server shared && npm --workspace server start
scripts.test: npm --workspace shared test && npm --workspace server test && npm --workspace client test
